Community Day

Pawniard Community Day

Sat, Nov 21, 2026, 2:00 PM → Sat, Nov 21, 2026, 5:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

Pawniard's Community Day (Nov 21, 2–5 p.m. local): lots of Pawniard, and evolving Bisharp in time gets a Kingambit with the exclusive Kowtow Cleave.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Featured move

  • Evolve Bisharp into Kingambit before 9 p.m. local time to get Kowtow Cleave, a Dark-type Charged Attack (power 85 in gyms and raids, 75 in trainer battles).

Bonuses during the event

  • Pawniard appears much more often.
  • 2× Candy for catching, and better odds of Candy XL for trainers level 31 and up.
  • Eggs put in incubators during the event need a quarter of the usual distance.

Until 9 p.m. local

  • Lure Modules keep attracting Pawniard.
  • Trades cost 50% less Stardust.

Special Research

  • Optional paid research (US$1.99 or your local equivalent) with extra Pawniard encounters, a Premium Battle Pass and a Rare Candy XL among the rewards.

Tip

Kingambit needs a Bisharp first, so evolve some Pawniard during the three hours, then evolve Bisharp before 9 p.m.
